messages:
Sarah (Sales): hey team — Acme just sent back the SIG with a few BCP/DR follow-ups they called 'must-have' for procurement: explicit RTO/RPO numbers, backup cadence & retention, cross-region failover behavior, DR test cadence, and restore verification. attaching their excerpt: <https://acme.example.com/sig-excerpt.pdf>

Mike (Solutions Eng): thanks. I drafted inline answers below — can you /security confirm we can sign off or flag anything sensitive? quick notes: RTO: 'service failover initiation within 60 minutes for critical control-plane incidents; full restoration target depends on data egress size and state reconciliation.' RPO: 'aim <= 5 minutes for persisted telemetry/state; ephemeral caches are best-effort and can be rebuilt.' backups: 'daily snapshots of customer metadata and config; 30-day retention; encrypted at rest and in transit.' failover: 'multi-AZ with automated regional failover via load-balancer and routing policies; cross-region failover supported for Dedicated/private deployments on request.' DR tests: 'tabletop quarterly, full restore annually (or on major infra changes)'. put that into CAIQ cell 3.2?

Julia (Security Ops): good draft. a few corrections before we give to legal/procurement: 1) remove any absolute guarantees tied to 3rd-party cloud egress — use 'target' language. 2) RTO: say 'initiate failover within 60 minutes and aim to restore service within 4 hours depending on scope' — customers often push for too-tight OS-level guarantees. 3) RPO: for user-facing request replay we can say '<= 5 minutes for persisted state; non-persistent KV cache not replicated'. 4) Backups: encrypted with KMS, object storage replication across two regions for hosted customers; immutable snapshots for 30 days. 5) DR tests: quarterly tabletop, semi-annual restore rehearsal for hosted + Dedicated customers on annual cadence for Private (or per contract). 6) add link to runbook: https://confluence.redwood.dev/dr-runbooks

Mike (Solutions Eng): perfect — I'll replace the absolutes. here's a trimmed answer block for the SIG/CAIQ cell (pasteable):

```
RTO / RPO:
- RTO: We initiate automated failover procedures within 60 minutes of detecting a catastrophic outage. Restoration timelines depend on outage scope; our target is to restore customer-facing service within 4 hours for most incidents, with ongoing communication and escalation for larger events.
- RPO: We aim for a recovery point objective of <= 5 minutes for persisted customer metadata and operational telemetry. Ephemeral caches and in-flight runtime state are best-effort and not promised as durable.

Backups & Retention:
- Daily encrypted snapshots of customer configuration and metadata retained for 30 days.
- Model artifacts and long-term artifacts are stored in encrypted object storage with cross-region replication for hosted deployments.

Failover & DR Tests:
- Production is deployed across multiple AZs; automated failover and health-routing are used to reduce customer impact.
- Cross-region failover is supported for customers on Dedicated and Private deployments; this can be included in contractual SLAs.
- Tabletop DR exercises are conducted quarterly; restore rehearsals are performed at least semi-annually for Hosted/Dedicated (annual for Private unless contract specifies otherwise).

Restore Verification & Runbooks:
- Restores are validated with smoke tests and post-restore data integrity checks; runbooks and escalation trees are maintained in our internal incident runbook repository: https://confluence.redwood.dev/dr-runbooks

Security Controls:
- All backups encrypted at rest with customer-keyed KMS options available for Dedicated/Private customers.
- Access to backup restore operations is restricted via RBAC and audited.
```

Sarah (Sales): this reads good and un-blocks procurement for the Acme deal. can we add one sentence about SLA uptime targets to the top for the exec summary? they asked specifically for uptime + RTO.

Julia (Security Ops): add: 'Our public SLA for Hosted API is 99.9% monthly uptime; Dedicated SLA can be contracted to a higher target.' avoid committing to exact monetary credits here — legal will add.

Mike (Solutions Eng): added SLA line to the exec summary. final pasteable answer ready. I'll send to Acme and flag legal & contracts to review wording around credits/penalties.

deploy-bot: scheduled:dr-rehearsal noted for Hosted env — next runbook dry-run on 2026-05-14 16:00 UTC (auto).

Sarah (Sales): thanks all — sending now. I'll ping again if procurement asks for restore logs or a sample restore report. :thumbsup:

Julia (Security Ops): if they ask for an audit artifact, we provide redacted restore rehearsals and table-top notes via our SOC pack. ping me and i'll pull it. :white_check_mark:
